units: <cite ref="Targum of II Chronicles 32:3">Targ. II Chr. XXXII, 3</cite>. Targ. II Esth. I, 2 (3) <he>ס׳ נפשיה</he> (the gate) closed itself; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>סְתִים</he>; f. <cite ref="O01697"><he>סְתִימָא</he></cite>; pl. <he>סְתִימִין</he>, <he>סְתִימַיָּא</he>; <cite ref="O01697"><he>סְתִימָן</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 41:16">Targ. Ez. XLI, 16</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 49:1">Targ. Y. I Gen. XLIX, 1</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Chullin 49b:14">Ḥull. 49ᵇ</cite> <he>חד סָתֵים</he> one of them stops up a perforation (by close adhesion, v. <cite ref="O01705">preced.</cite>).

Ib. sq. אינהו … ולדידן מִיסְתַּם נמי לא ס׳ they eat (that kind of fat), and for us was it not even to have the effect of closing up the perforation (that the animal in the case be permitted)?; a. fr.—Esp. to conceal an authority; to state a law without naming the author.

<cite ref="Beitzah 2a:10">Bets. 2ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 24:4">Sabb. XXIV, 4</cite>) <he>דס׳ לן תנא כר״ש</he> where the editor of the Mishnah states the law anonymously, in agreement with R. S.’s opinion. Ib.ᵇ (ref. to <cite ref="Mishnah Beitzah 4:3">Bets. IV, 3</cite>) <he>דס׳ לן תנא כד״י</he> where the editor gives R. Judah’s opinion anonymously; a. fr.

<cite ref="Gittin 68a:10">Gitt. 68ᵃ</cite> <he>וסַתְּמִינְהוּ בגבבי וכ׳</he> and stopped the waters up with wool.—Part. pass. <he>מְסַתַּם</he>; f. <he>מְסַתְּמָא</he>; pl. <he>מְסַתְּמִין</he>; <he>מְסַתְּמָן</he>.
<cite ref="Megillah 3a">Meg. 3ᵃ</cite> in the Prophets <he>איכא מילי … דמ׳</he> (Ms. O. <he>דסְתִימָן</he>) some things are clearly stated, others obscurely.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Esther 8:10">Targ. Esth. VIII, 10</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Esther 5:14">Ib. V, 14</cite> (some ed. <he>אסתממו</he>, incorr.); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 15:3">Targ. Y. Lev. XV, 3</cite> <he>אִיתְסַתַּם</he> (v. <cite ref="H01900"><he>חֲתַם</he></cite>).—
<cite ref="Ketubot 106a:1">Keth. 106ᵃ</cite> <he>איסתתם טענתיה</he> (v. <cite ref="O01705">preced.</cite>) he declared he had nothing to say (was intimidated).

<cite ref="Shevuot 30b:4">Shebu. 30ᵇ</cite> <he>מִסְתַּתְּמָן טענתיה דבעל וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>קמִסְתַּתְּמָא</he>) the opponent will be intimidated; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 922">Yalk. Deut. 922</cite> <he>מִיסַּתְּמָא טענתיה וכ׳</he>; a. e.
